buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. He/she may be required to drive official vehicles for conveyance of the Director & Senior Officer. 2. Proper cleanliness and maintenance of Car. 3. Maintenance of Log book. 4. Records of petrol consumed/taken and other prescribed records are also part of his/her duties. 5. He/she is also responsible to get servicing/repair of cars done under his/her direct supervision, wherever required. 6. Knowledge of motor mechanism. 7. In addition, he/she will be required to perform such other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned to him/her from time to time. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Experience in providing similar type of manpower service in the office of Chandigarh Administration. Do cumentary evidence should be uploaded on GeM portal. 2. EPF/ESI no of Chandigarh region. Documentary evidence should be uploaded on GeM portal. 3. No complaint/incident should be raise on GeM Portal against the bidder in respect of any matter. 4. Registered office of service provider should be in tricity i.e. Chandigarh, Mohali & Panchkula. 5. Performance Security should be submit to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract in form of Bank Guarantee in favour of DIRECTOR, DIRECTORATE OF CENSUS OPERATIONS, UT CHANDIGARH. 6. Bid Security : - In place of a Bid Security, the participating firm will accept a Bid Securing declaration acc ording to which if the firm withdraws or modifies bids during period of validity etc. their firm will accept sus pension for a specified period as deemed fit by appropriate authority of the Directorate of Census Operatio ns, UT Chandigarh. 7. The existing driver deployed in the office will be retained. 8. Attendance at the Pre-Bid Meeting is mandatory for all prospective bidders. The date, time, and venue/o nline meeting details shall be as specified in the bid document. Each bidder shall depute an authorized rep resentative to attend the meeting, who must produce a valid authorization letter issued by the bidder. An attendance certificate shall be issued by the Buyer to the authorized representative present at the Pre-Bid Meeting. The bidder shall upload the attendance certificate along with the bid documents. Failure to attend the Pre-Bid Meeting and/or failure to upload the attendance certificate shall render the bid liable for rejecti on during the technical evaluation. . 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of DIRECTOR, DIRECTORATE OF CENSUS OPERATIONS, UT CHANDIGARH.

A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
